sections.heading: Purpose of this screen
body: The Reminders screen is where you manage recurring care schedules for your plants.
A reminder defines what should be done (task type), how often it repeats (interval), and which plant it belongs to. Based on that, Flovers generates tasks automatically over time.

sections.heading: Reminder list view
body: In the list view, each tile represents a single reminder created by the user.
The tile shows the task type (icon and name), the plant name, the location (if assigned), how often it repeats, and when it is due next.
This view is the fastest way to review all recurring rules currently active in your account.

sections.heading: Reminder tile actions (Edit / Pause / Resume / Plant details / Delete)
body: You can edit, pause, resume or delete each reminder.
Edit lets you change reminder parameters such as interval, task type, associated plant, and other reminder settings (depending on the reminder type).

Pause temporarily disables a reminder without deleting it. While paused, its due task is removed from Home and daily email or push notifications will not include it. When you resume the reminder, Flovers schedules the next pending task according to the reminder interval.
Plant details: navigates directly to the Plant Details view for the related plant.
Deleting a reminder permanently deletes all its tasks, including completed history and saved notes. No further tasks are generated. Pause instead if you want to keep the history.

sections.heading: FAB actions
body: The Reminders FAB offers Add reminder, Sort, Filter and Clear filter when applicable. Calendar/List switching is available in Home instead.
Sorting can be applied by due date, plant name, or location.
Filtering can be applied by plant name, location, task type, and due date range.

sections.heading: How reminders generate tasks (general logic)
body: A reminder is a recurring rule (for example: Water every 7 days).
Flovers generates tasks from reminders and presents them on the Home screen as actionable items.
The next task is calculated from the completion date you choose, using the reminder interval. If necessary, intervals are repeated until the next date is strictly after today.

sections.heading: Notes and practical tips
body: Reminders help you stay consistent, but they do not guarantee plant health—real conditions may require adjusting intervals.
If you change your environment (season, light, substrate, pot size), consider updating reminders to match the new conditions.
To review completed tasks, their notes and progress photos, use Task Journal.
Each plant can have only one reminder per care type. Edit the existing reminder instead of adding another of the same type.

sections.heading: Reminder definitions stay with the owner
body: Reminders is a list for managing your own recurring reminder definitions: add, edit, pause, resume or delete them. The task calendar is now in Home. Sharing a plant makes its generated tasks available according to sharing permissions; it does not grant access to the reminder definitions.
